'''Semage''' was a [[human]] [[Raxus guard|guard]] who served under [[Senator]] [[Larik]] of the Galactic Republic. Semage, along with [[Hanel]], wanted to force the corrupt Larik to [[Raxus Secundus]], but were both stopped by [[Jedi Master]]s [[Dooku]] and [[Mace Windu]], after [[Jedi]] Master [[Katri]] was [[Death|murdered]] on the [[planet]]. Semage and Hanel tried to kill the two Jedi but were overwhelmed. Semage was arrested by the two Jedi while Hanel was killed in an ensuing fight. Semage was placed in [[prison]] with the other conspirators, but was visited by Dooku, who told them not to lose heart for the fight.<ref name="TOTJ" />
